chunks: Whoever completes the recitation of the Qur'an in Makkah, from one Friday to another, or in less time, or more, Allah, Mighty and Majestic, writes for him reward and good deeds from the first Friday that was in the world to the last Friday that will be. And likewise if he completes it on the rest of the days.

key_terms.الْحَسَنَاتِ: good deeds recorded for the servant
key_terms.الْقُرْآنَ: the Qur'an being recited in full

ai.seo_question: What is the reward for completing the recitation of the Qur'an in Makkah?
ai.summary: This hadith encourages completing the recitation of the Qur'an in Makkah and describes an immense reward for doing so. It states that whether the completion occurs between two Fridays, in less time, or more, Allah grants reward and good deeds spanning from the first Friday in the world to the last, and the same principle applies on other days as well.
